recipesData.name: Communion Bread
directions: Combine flour and oil and enough water to make it hold together.
Press into desired thickness and cut into desired sizes
Poke holes
Cook at 350°F until fully cooked
recipesData.creator: Daniel

recipesData.name: Pizza Calzones

ingredients.ingredientText: Italian sausage, pepperoni, mozzarella cheese , or whatever filling you want

directions: In a mixing bowl, combine 3 cups flour, yeast, brown sugar, and salt.
In a saucepan, heat the water and oil to 120-130 degrees. Add to dry ingredients and beat until smooth.
Stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough. Turn onto a floured surface; knead until smooth and elastic, about 4 minutes.
Cover and let rest in a warm place for 15 minutes.
Divide dough into 8  pieces. On a floured surface, roll each piece into a 7-inch circle.
On half, place sauce and any other filling ingredients.
Fold dough over filling; pinch seams to seal.
Combine flour and oil and enough water to make it hold together.
Yield:8 servings
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Hint of Honey Honey Wheat Bread

ingredients.ingredientText: 1 Tbsp. active dry yeast (I use 1 packet of instant yeast)
1 1/2 - 2 cups white whole wheat flour (I use all purpose flour)

directions: Combine honey and warm water in a large glass or plastic bowl. Add yeast and let sit 10 minutes or until frothy. For instant yeast, just combine the water and honey. The yeast goes in the dry ingredients.
Add the 2 cups of whole wheat flour, and stir until no dry clumps remain. Cover and let sit at least 30 minutes until bubbly.

Stir in the salt and 1 cup of while whole wheat flour, mixing until the dough pulls away from the side of the bowl. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead, adding the remaining flour as necessary as necessary to prevent sticking, 8-10 minutes until smooth (I usually add the remaining flour before kneading). Return dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place 1 hour, or until doubled in size.

Lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Punch down the dough and form into a log (I press the dough out and roll into a log). Place dough into bottom of the loaf pan and cover with greased plastic wrap. Let rise in a warm place for 1 hour or until doubled.

Preheat oven to 350 F. Bake in preheated oven for 30-35 minutes, until golden brown on top (the loaf will sound hollow when tapped). Remove from pan to cool on wire rack. Cool completely before slicing.
recipesData.creator: Daniel

recipesData.name: Hot Air Popper Popcorn
directions: Add popcorn to hot Air Popper. Plug in the Popper and let it pop.
recipesData.creator: Daniel

recipesData.name: JoJo's Biscuits

ingredients.ingredientText: 2 large eggs plus 1 egg for brushing
1.5 cups Buttermilk plus 1 tablespoon for brushing

directions: In a large bowl, wisk together flour, baking powder, and baking soda.
Add butter and use a pastry blender to cut the butter into the flour until thr pieces are even and about the size of peas.

Stir in the beaten eggs with a spoon until combined. Stir in Buttermilk until dough comes together into a sticky mass. If it is too dry, add more Buttermilk until it reached thr correct consistency. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to overnight.
Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line baking sheet with parchment paper.
Scrape dough onto floured work surface. Use your floured hands to press it into a circle about .5 inches thick.
Cut biscuits.
Transfer biscuits to baking sheet.
In a small dish, best together the remaining egg snd Buttermilk and brush over biscuits.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes.
recipesData.creator: sueodom

recipesData.name: Overnight French Toast
directions: 1. Grease 9x13 pan and arrange bread slices in dish.
2. Beat eggs in bowl. Add cream, milk, granulated sugar, and extract. Pour over bread. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
3. Preheat oven to 375°F.
4. Place brown sugar and flour in bowl with softened butter and mix. Sprinkle on French toast.
5. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipesData.creator: sueodom

recipesData.name: Chicken Pot Pie

ingredients.ingredientText: 2 22.6 ounce cans cream of chicken or mushroom

directions: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F and spray a 9x13 pan.
2. In a large pot, melt butter. Add onion and cook till transparent. Add carrots and cook till soften. Stir in flour.
3. Wisk in chicken broth until flour is incorporated. Stir in condensed soup. Bring to boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
4. Remove from heat and add chicken and peas. Season to taste. Pour into baking dish.
5. Cover with Cresent rolls and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipesData.creator: sueodom

recipesData.name: Alfredo Sauce
directions: 1. Melt butter in sauce pan. Add garlic until aromatic.
2. Wisk cream and cook over low heat until bubbling and tickened.
3. Wisk in parmesan and white pepper until well combined.
4. Serve with pasta.
recipesData.creator: sueodom

recipesData.name: Italian Chicken and Rice

ingredients.ingredientText: 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (1-1/2 pounds)

directions: In a large resealable plastic bag or shallow bowl, combine the first 4 ingredients.
Place 1/3 cup mn in another bowl. Dip chicken in milk, the coat with the cheese mixture.
In a greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish, combine water, rice, salt if desired and remaining milk; mix well.
Top with chicken. Drizzle with butter.
Bake, uncovered, at 425 degrees for 25-30 minutes or until the rice is tender and chicken juices run clear.
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Santa Fe Chicken

ingredients.ingredientText: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (about 1 pound)

directions: In  a large skillet, saute onion in butter until tender. Add broth and salsa; bring to a boil.
Stir in rice and garlic powder. Place chicken over rice; cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Turn chicken; cook 10-15 minutes longer or until meat juices run clear. Remove from the heat.
Sprnkle with cheese; cover and let stand for 5 minutes.
Yield 4 servings.
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Ravioli Casserole
directions: Spread 1/2 cup of spaghetti sauce in an ungreased 9 x 13 inch baking dish.
Layer with half the ravioli, 1-1/4 cups of sauce, 1 cup cottage cheese, 2 cups mozzarella cheese, half the sausage.
Repeat layers. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake, uncovered, at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes or until bubbly. Let stand 5-10 minutes before serving.
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Southwestern Chicken

ingredients.ingredientText: 2 cans (15-1/4 oz each) whole kernel corn, drained (I use frozen corn)
1 can (15 oz ) black beans, rinsed and drained

directions: Combine the corn, black beans, and 1/2 cup salsa in a slow cooker.
Top with chicken; pour the remaning salsa over the chicken.
Cover and cook on high for 3-4 hours or on low for 7-8 hours or until meat juices run clear.
Sprinkle with cheese; cover until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Fast Baked Fish
directions: Place fish in a greased 11 x 7 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with seasoned salt, pepper and paprika  if desired. Drizzle with butter.
Cover an bake at 400 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.
Yield: 4 servings
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Frozen Blueberry Muffins

ingredients.ingredientText: 2 cups frozen blueberries, unthawed (fresh blueberries can be used)
Topping:  2 tablespoons sugar and 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg combined

directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, baking powder and salt.
In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, milk and vanilla; mix well.
Stir in the dry ingredients just until moistened. Fold in frozen bluberries.
Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups 2/3 full. Sprinkle Topping mixture over muffins.
Bake at 375 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until muffins test done.
Cool in pan or 10 minutesbefore removing to a wire rack.
Yield: about 2 dozen
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Cherry Cheesecake Pie

ingredients.ingredientText: 2 packages (one 8 oz, one 3 oz) cream cheese, softened
1 carton (8 oz) frozen whipped topping, thawed (Cool Whip)
1 shortbread or graham cracker crust (8 or 9 inches)
1 can (21 oz) cherry pie filling (any type of topping will work)

directions: In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth.
Fold in whipped topping; spoon into crust.
Top with pie filling (it works better to top as you eat it because it gets runny otherwise.)
Refrigerate until serving.
Yield :  6-8 servings.
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Peanut Butter Apple Dip
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine the first 4 ingredients; mix well.
Serve with apples. Store in refrigerator.
Yield: 2-2/3 cups.
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Picnic Bars
directions: In a bowl, combine flour, sugar and cocoa; cut in butter until mixture resemble coarse crumbs
Stir in eggs
Set side 1-1/2 cups for topping
Press remaining crumb mixture into a greased 9 x 13 inch baking pan
Bake at 350 degrees for 6-8 minutes or until set
Meanwhile, in a saucepan, combine the mik and 1 cup of chocolate chips; cook and stir over low heat until melted
Carefull spread over crust
Combne reserved crumb mixture with nuts and remaining chocolate chips
Sprinkle over chocolate layer
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until top is set (chips will not look melted)
Cool before cutting
Yield: 3 dozen
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Speedy Brownies
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine the first 7 ingredients; beat until smooth
Pour into greased 9 x 13 baking pan
Sprinkle with chocolate chips
Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
Cool in a pan on a wire rack
Yield: about 3 dozen
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugars
Add peanut butter, egg, and vanilla; beat until smooth
Combine the flour, baking soda and baking powder; add to the cramed mixture and mix well
For easier shaping, chill the dough for 1 hour
Shape into 1-inch balls; place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets
Flatten each ball by crisscrossing with the tines of a fork dipped in sugar
Bake at 375 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until botoms ar elightly browned and cookies are set
Yield: about 4 dozen
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Banana Pudding Dessert

ingredients.ingredientText: 1 package (3.4 oz) instant vanilla pudding mix
1 carton (8 oz) frozen whipped topping, thawed

directions: In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth
Beat in condensed milk; set aside
In another bowl, whisk milk and pudding mix; add to cream cheese mixture
Fold in whipped topping
Arrange a  third of the vanilla wafers in a 2-1/2 quart glass bowl
Top with a third of the bananas and pudding mixture
Repeat layers twice
Refrigerate until serving
Yield: 10-12 servings
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Chocolate Carmel Cookies

ingredients.ingredientText: 1 cup chopped pecans, divided (I don't use the pecans)

directions: In a mixing bowl, cram butter, 1 cup sugar and brown sugar
Add eggs and vanila; mix well
Combine flour, cocoa and baking soda;; add to the cramed mixture and beat just until combined
Stir in 1/2 cup pecans
Shape dough by tablespoonfuls around each candy
In a smal bowl, combine remainng pecans and sugar; dipeach cookie halfway
Place with nut side up on an ungreased baking sheets
Bake at 375 degrees for 7-10 minutes or until top is slightly cracked
Cool for 3 minutes; remove to wire racks to cool completely
Yield: about 5 dozen
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Sheet Pan Sausage and Veggies

ingredients.ingredientText: 2 cups 1/2 in diced potatoes or sweet potatoes
1 tablespoon Italian seasoning or other seasoning
Other veggies like carrots, onions, and zucchini are good

directions: Heat oven to 400 degrees F
Slice sausage into 1 in rounds
dice potatoes into 1/2 in cubes
chop veggies
mix ingredients until evenly combined
put in a sheet pan
Bake for 20 min flipping halfway
recipesData.creator: Daniel

recipesData.name: Caramelized Apples
directions: Peel and core apples
Cut each apple into quarters and each quarter into quarters
Melt butter over medium high heat
Once butter has almost melted, add brown sugar followed by the apples
Cook and toss apples until they are nicely caramelized on all sides and tender
recipesData.creator: Daniel

recipesData.name: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas

ingredients.ingredientText: 1 1/2 cups cooked chickpeas drained and rinsed
extra virgin olive oil for drizzling

directions: Heat oven to 425 F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper
Spread chickpeas on towel and pat them dry, removing any loose skins
Toss chickpeas in olive oil drizzle and generous pinches of salt and put in pan
Roast chickpeas for 20-40 minutes or until golden brown and crisp
Remove from oven and while still warm, toss with favorite spices
recipesData.creator: Daniel

recipesData.name: Baked Oatmeal Cups

ingredients.ingredientText: 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce or mashed banana
1/3 cup mini chocolate chips or dried fruit

directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F
Spray a 12 cup muffin tin with non stick spray or line with paper liners
In a bowl mix together apple sauce, eggs, peanut butter, brown sugar, vanilla and milk until well combined
In a separate bowl mix together oats, baking powder, cinnamon and chocolate chips
Slowly add oat mixture to the wet ingredients until combined
Add in melted butter and stir to combine
Divide batter evenly between the 12 muffin cups
Make sure there is equal amount of liquid in each cup
Top with chocolate chips and bake for 18-20 minutes until they are set and starting to turn golden brown on top
Remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes before removing from the pan to a wire rack to cool completely
Once cool store in an air tight container in the fridge for up to a week
recipesData.creator: Daniel

recipesData.name: Protein Balls

ingredients.ingredientText: 1/2 cup pumpkin or sunflower seeds or mix

directions: Mix together
Chill 1-2 hours
Roll out or press
Lasts in fridge 1 week or in freezer up to 3 months
recipesData.creator: Daniel

recipesData.name: Instant Pot  Chicken and Sausage Jambalya with Shrimp

ingredients.ingredientText: 13 oz Andouille or pork thinly sliced
28 oz stewed tomatoes ( I use crushed)
I  double the veggies. Ifit is not spicy enough you can add 1/2 tsp pepper and 1 tsp  Cayenne pepper (I tried it with them and it was too hot)

directions: Add the oil and chicken to instant pot and  click saute-  cook until browned
Add the butter, onion, green pepper, and celery- stir and cook
Add the sausage and garlic- stir

Add 1/2 cup broth and deglaze the pot well
Add the rest of the chicken broth, rice, seasonings and stewed tomatoes- stir
Place the bay leaves on top and close the instant pot
Make sure the pressure valve is in the closed position
Pressure cook on high for 7 minutes
Do quick release and open the instant pot
Add the shrimp and close the  instant pot again- let the residual heat  ook the shrimp for 10 minutes
Open, remove bay leaves, stir and stir
recipesData.creator: mamalinda

recipesData.name: Oven Baked Chicken Breasts
directions: preheat oven 400 F
toss chicken in olive oil and seasonings
place in a lightly greased pan
bake for 22-26 minutes (22 for smaller; 26 for larger) until internal temp reaches 165 F
rest for 5 minutes before slicing
recipesData.creator: Daniel

recipesData.name: Slow Cooker Country Style Pork Ribs
directions: Spray 4-5 quart slow cooker with cooking spray or use alow cooker bag
Place ribs in slow cooker
mix together remaining ingredients and pour over ribs
ook on low for 9-10 hours
recipesData.creator: Daniel

recipesData.name: Crockpot Little Smokies
directions: Place little smokies into a crockpot
Whisk everything else together in a separate bowl
Poor sauce over little smokies
Cook on low for at least 2 hours
(or high if doubling recipe)
recipesData.creator: Daniel

recipesData.name: Slow Cooker Teriyaki Chicken

ingredients.ingredientText: 2 tablespoons rice vinegar (apple cider vinegar works too)

directions: place chicken breasts in slow cooker
In a small bowl, whisk together the garlic, ginger, honey, brown sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, and vinegar. I double the sauce recipe
Pour soy sauce mixture over chicken
Cover and cook on HIGH for 4-5 hours or LOW for 8 hours
Remove Chicken from slow cooker and shred with two forks
Pour teriyaki sauce from slow cooker through a strainer into a sauce pan
Place saucepan on the stove over medium high heat and bring to a simmer
In a small bowl mix the cornstarch with the water until dissolved
Pour cornstarch into the pan and brind to a boil
Cook for 1-2 minutes or until sauce has just thickened
Pour sauce over the shredded chicken and toss to coat
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions and serve
recipesData.creator: Daniel

recipesData.name: Instant Pot Chicken Broccoli Rice Casserole

ingredients.ingredientText: 1 1/4 tsp kosher salt or 3/4 tsp table salt

directions: Turn on the Sauté setting
When it is hot, add the olive oil and butter
Add the onion and cook for about 3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until starting to turn translucent
Add the chicken
Sprinkle the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and thyme over it
Stir
Cook, stirring occasionally until just the outside of the chicken turns white
Add the minced garlic and stir
Add the rice and broth
Do not stir
Gently press the rice and chicken into the broth, then put the lid on the pressure cooker and set the steam release knob to the Sealing position
Turn off the Sauté setting
Press the Pressure Cook/Manual button or dial, then select 3 minutes on High Pressure
The pot will take several minutes to come to pressure
When the Chicken and rice is cooking, run the frozen broccoli under hot water and drain
Set aside
If using fresh broccoli, you may need to microwave it with a little water to soften it, as it won't cook in the pot with the residual heat
If the florets are large, cut them in half
When the cook cycle has finished, turn off pot and let it sit undisturbed for 10 minutes (10 minutes natural release)
Then turn the steam release knob to the Venting position to release the remaining steam/pressure
Open Lid when pin in lid drops
Stir in cheese
Add broccoli florets, stir, and close the lid so it cooks in the residual heat of the rice/chicken
(might need to cook the frozen florets if not thawed all the way)
Serve
Makes good leftovers
recipesData.creator: Daniel

recipesData.name: Granola

ingredients.ingredientText: 1 1/2 cups raw nuts and or seeds
1 tsp fine grain sea salt or 3/4 tsp table salt
1/2 cup melted coconut oil or olive oil
2/3 cup dried fruit, chopped if large

directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and line a large, rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper
In a large mixing bowl, combine the oats, nuts and/or seeds, salt and cinnamon
Stir to blend
Pour in the oil, maple syrup and/or honey and vanilla
Mix well, until every oat and nut is lightly coated
Pour the granola onto your prepared pan and use a large spoon to spread it in an even layer
Bake until lightly golden, about 21 to 24 minutes, stirring halfway (for extra-clumpy granola, press the stirred granola down with your spatula to create a more even layer)
The granola will further crisp up as it cools
Let the granola cool completely, undisturbed (at least 45 minutes)
Top with the dried fruit (and optional chocolate chips, if using)
Break the granola into pieces with your hands if you want to retain big chunks, or stir it around with a spoon if you don’t want extra-clumpy granola
Store the granola in an airtight container at room temperature for 1 to 2 weeks, or in a sealed freezer bag in the freezer for up to 3 months
The dried fruit can freeze solid, so let it warm to room temperature for 5 to 10 minutes before serving
recipesData.creator: Daniel
